issues: 痛点警示条是深色块 + 三角 + 灰条，解决卡是空 Card，读不出前后语义
警示条与解决卡长时间交叉淡化，叠成一块灰
滚正前没有蓄力，斜置期只有几何上的歪、没有情绪
changes: 警示条换成失败构建 toast（红色侧条、图标、'Build failing on main / 3 checks failed · 12 deploys blocked'、View logs）；解决卡换成成功 toast（勾线描出、'All checks passing'、Healthy chip）
警示条 8f ease-in 上移收走，解决卡晚 6f snappy 上浮接替，只重叠 2f；图标 overshoot 弹出、标题/副标/chip 2–3f 错峰
滚正前 6f 再压 0.6° 蓄力，再 14f 冲过 0 到 +1.2°、10f 收回；斜置期叠暖色压暗暗角（不适），随滚正散去（释然）
补导出 DUTCH_ROLL_TO_LEVEL_DURATION=150，落定后真静止 56f
issuesEn: The pain banner was a dark block with a triangle and a grey bar, and the solution was an empty Card, so the before/after meaning didn't read
Banner and solution card crossfaded for a long stretch and merged into a grey slab
No wind-up before the roll; the tilted state was only geometrically crooked, with no emotional cue
changesEn: The banner is now a failing-build toast (red edge, icon, 'Build failing on main / 3 checks failed · 12 deploys blocked', View logs); the solution is a success toast (check stroke draws on, 'All checks passing', Healthy chip)
The banner exits up with ease-in in 8f and the success toast rises 6f later with a snappy ease, overlapping only 2f; the icon pops with overshoot and title/subtitle/chip stagger 2–3f
A 0.6° wind-up over 6f before the roll, then 14f past 0 to +1.2° and 10f back; a warm darkening vignette during the tilt (unease) clears as it levels (relief)
Exported DUTCH_ROLL_TO_LEVEL_DURATION=150 with a 56f true hold after leveling
